Corollary
[Two-generator involutions] 1. Geometric Corollary 5.4.2\group hyperbolic 3-manifoldsSource: thurston:page-0106 A complete hyperbolic $3$--manifold whose group is generated by $a,b$ has an order-two isometry inverting both generators. If $a,b$ are conjugate and have no common fixed point at infinity, a second commuting involution exchanges them.
